messages.subject: deploy app with images
parts:
Hi, this question is very important and urgent. Any help would be really appreciated. 

I am trying to deploy my shinyapp on shinyapps.io. It runs correctly locally but when visualised in shinyapps.io there is a problem. Pictures are not displayed, but there is the logo with the broken image. They images are contained in the folder "www" which is a sub-folder of the app folder where there are the "server" and "ui" files. 
I am using the code 
img(src= "m3.png", height = '20px', width = '20px') where m3 is the image name.
for each images, 
There are several images to be displayed depening on "if" statements. 

Url for the app: 
https://ciaperonimartino.shinyapps.io/facial/

Thank you,

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] deploy app with images
parts:
Hi,

I would double check the casing on your image paths. Shinyapps.io runs Linux which means filenames are case sensitive. That includes the file extension (.PNG vs .png).

Best,
-Andy
